text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Estate Duty (Chan Kee Hwa, Deceased) (Remission) Order 2006.
2. The sum of $2,571,587.98 payable under the Act on the Estate of Chan Kee Hwa, Deceased, being interest on the unpaid estate duty from 11th May 1997 to 4th May 2006, is hereby remitted.
